semantics: Base update obtains loaded wrapper and starts native AssetBundle.LoadAssetAsync once; derived operation remains queued until request done.
Done publishes typed manifest (including null) then Update false. Explicit repeated Update republishes.
IsDone has no request: error null false, any nonnull error logs and true, including 0 and empty; manager Update still true on missing wrapper.
LoadManifest existing loaded bundle Unload(true) then remove, Load(name,true), construct AssetBundleManifest operation and add shared queue; previous Manifest not cleared.
pendingEvidence: Original manager native/static owner and full startup composition pending.
